meta.title: Kıvanç Kız Yurdu — Female Student Residence in Avcılar, Istanbul
meta.description: A private residence for female students in Avcılar, Istanbul. Secure, professionally managed rooms minutes from Istanbul's private universities.

hero.title: A student residence that feels like home
hero.lede: A private residence for female students in the heart of Avcılar — professionally managed, secure around the clock, and a short walk from the Metrobüs that reaches five university campuses in under half an hour.
hero.imageAlt: The entrance and common seating area at Kıvanç Kız Yurdu

rooms.title: Hotel-style rooms, four ways to share
rooms.lede: 45 rooms across the building, in four sizes. Every one of them is hotel-style — its own bathroom and WC inside the room, a TV, a mini fridge and a brand-new study set. What changes between them is how many people share, and what that does to the monthly rate.
rooms.disclaimer: Campaign rates for the new term, per person. The term price covers 10 months and can be paid as a deposit plus instalments — the full breakdown is on the rooms page.

f1.name: Single Room
f1.desc: A hotel-style room of your own, with a private bathroom and WC, a TV, a mini fridge and a brand-new study set.
f1.alt: A single room with one bed, a bedside table and a full-height wardrobe

f2.name: Double Room
f2.desc: Two beds in a hotel-style room with its own bathroom and WC, a TV and a mini fridge. Our most popular choice.
f2.alt: A double room with two beds, a television and its own bathroom

f3.name: Triple Room
f3.desc: Three beds, with the bathroom and WC inside the room, a TV and a mini fridge — the same standard at a lower monthly rate.
f3.alt: Shared room with bunk beds and individual storage

rooms.residenceNote: A dedicated building with keycard entry, a resident manager living on site and 24-hour camera monitoring.

f4.name: Quad Room
f4.desc: Four beds and the most affordable rate in the building, with the same private bathroom, TV and mini fridge as every other room.

uni.title: Close to where you study
uni.lede: Avcılar sits directly on the Metrobüs corridor, with İstanbul Gelişim inside the district itself and four more campuses within half an hour along the same line. Travel times below are door-to-door by public transport.
uni.note: Travel times are typical off-peak estimates by public transport and can vary with traffic and time of day.

amen.title: Everything included, nothing to think about
amen.lede: One monthly payment covers the room, the bills and the services around it — so students can put their attention where it belongs.

2.title: 24/7 camera recording
2.desc: Every common area and entrance is recorded around the clock and reviewed regularly.

3.title: Fibre Wi-Fi
3.desc: High-speed fibre in every room and lounge, built to handle exam season.

4.title: Hotel-style rooms
4.desc: A TV, a mini fridge and a private bathroom in every room, with brand-new furniture.

6.desc: Washers and dryers included in your rent — no coins, no queues.

8.desc: Weekly room cleaning and daily upkeep of every shared space.

about.title: Built for students. Answerable to parents.
about.p1: Most of our residents move to Istanbul from another city, and for their families that first year is a leap of faith. We built Kıvanç around that reality: one properly staffed building, clear rules, transparent pricing, and someone reachable whenever a parent needs an answer.
about.p2: We're not a large chain. The residence is run day to day by the same family that has owned it since 2013, which is why the standards hold.
about.imageAlt: A double room with two beds, study desks, a television and a mini fridge

v1.title: Safety comes first
v1.desc: Controlled entry, 24/7 camera recording and staff on site at every hour — and entries and exits reported to the family as they happen.

v2.title: We answer in your language
v2.desc: Turkish and English support today, with Arabic-speaking staff for international students.

v3.title: Transparent pricing
v3.desc: One monthly figure covering bills, cleaning, laundry and meals. No surprises mid-year.

v4.title: A real community
v4.desc: Study groups, shared meals and events that make a new city feel smaller.

faq.title: Before you apply
faq.lede: If your question isn't here, call or message us — we answer in Turkish and English, seven days a week.

1.q: How do I apply for a room?
1.a: Send us the form at the bottom of this page or message us on WhatsApp with your name, university and preferred room type. We'll confirm availability, invite you for a visit, and hold the room with a deposit once you decide.

2.a: The standard contract runs for the academic year, from September to June. Summer stays and shorter terms are available on request, subject to availability.

3.q: What does the monthly price include?
3.a: Rent, all utilities, fibre internet, weekly room cleaning, laundry facilities, use of the study lounges and gym, and the daily meal plan. There is no separate bill at the end of the month.

4.q: Can parents visit, and what are the security rules?
4.a: Families are welcome during visiting hours and are received in the ground-floor lounge. Entry to the residence floors is by keycard and limited to residents and staff. Every entrance is recorded around the clock, reception is staffed 24 hours a day, and each student's entry and exit can be sent straight to her family on WhatsApp or Telegram.

5.a: Monthly by bank transfer, or in instalments agreed at signing. We issue a receipt for every payment and never ask for cash without documentation.

6.a: Yes. The building closes at 23:00 on weekdays and at midnight at weekends. A student who needs to return later, or to stay out overnight, arranges it with the resident manager in advance and her family is informed.
